title: Google\Cloud\Dlp\V2\InfoTypeTransformations
name: InfoTypeTransformations
description: A type of transformation that will scan unstructured text and apply various PrimitiveTransformations to each finding, where the transformation is applied to only values that were identified as a specific info_type.

params.name: data
params.description: Optional. Data for populating the Message object.

params.name: data.transformations
params.description: Required. Transformation for each infoType. Cannot specify more than one for a given infoType.

methods.name: getTransformations
methods.description: Required. Transformation for each infoType. Cannot specify more than one for a given infoType.

methods.name: setTransformations
methods.description: Required. Transformation for each infoType. Cannot specify more than one for a given infoType.
